decision: The competitor (Alfa Romeo F1 Team ORLEN) is fined €1,000.
event_name: Alfa Romeo F1 Team ORLEN Document 14 Date 27 May 2022 Time 14:29 2022 MONACO GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 May 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 34.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Car 77 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 60 km/h for this Event by 21.9 km/h. Garry Connelly Andrew Mallalieu Derek Warwick Jean-Francois Calmes
rules_referenced: Article 34.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Offence Car 77 Pit Lane Speeding
